AUSTIN, Texas — Tamaulipas’ anti-corruption prosecutor has located former Nuevo Laredo mayor Óscar Enrique “R” at a family home in Austin, Texas, and is asking U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) to deport him to Mexico so he can face a criminal case alleging more than 50 million pesos in damage to city finances, according to Somos Tamaulipas.

The Fiscalía Especializada en Combate a la Corrupción (FECC) confirmed the location, the outlet reports, and Mexico has already filed the deportation request with ICE — a strategy chosen instead of a formal international extradition, with coordination underway with Mexico’s attorney general’s office (FGR) and the Tamaulipas state attorney general’s office. The outlet’s reporting, first aired by Noticiero Victoria, says the former official was found at a family residence in the Texas capital, where he allegedly remains after entering the United States on a tourist visa with a travel permit allowing movement beyond the border zone.

The case: CP 38/2023

The pending matter, case CP 38/2023, centers on a 2021 land purchase allegedly executed at an inflated price during his administration, which investigators say cost Nuevo Laredo taxpayers more than 50 million pesos. The allegations include improper exercise of functions, abuse of authority, and misuse of powers and faculties. Óscar Enrique “R” led the Nuevo Laredo municipal government from 2016 to 2021 under the PAN party banner. He was formally charged in July 2025 and ordered into justified preventive detention, but court appeals allowed him to remain free while his legal challenges were resolved, according to the report.

An arrest warrant remains active. The deportation request is now pending, and any transfer would depend on determinations by immigration authorities in both countries. As with every case we cover, he is presumed innocent until proven guilty in court.

Webb Watch 956 previously reported the Interpol red notice sought against the former mayor; this deportation request marks a new and separate development in the same saga.

Sources:

title: Ex Nuevo Laredo mayor located in Austin as Tamaulipas prosecutors ask ICE to deport him
